reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone, Apollo DN3500, Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01

initial_state.guest_screen: HP VUE and File Manager visible; bin icon unselected

tests.result: Cursor moved one pixel right in the frame capture; override cleared cleanly and baseline counters returned to x=3,y=106.

tests.method: bounded helper movement, dx=-3, 100 steps, interval 2 frames
tests.result: Native pointer moved about 157 pixels left while the override was active; helper completed and cleared its fields without error.

tests.method: second bounded movement in a separate operation, dx=-3, 100 steps, interval 10 frames
tests.result: The cursor returned near the original host-accumulator reference instead of continuing the prior displacement; separate cleared batches are not cumulative.

conclusion: Single counter movement is observable without capturing the host pointer. The helper's bounded, separately cleared operations do not accumulate toward an XmpIcon target, so this route did not produce a selection/focus comparison. No guest item was clicked or opened.
next: Use a deliberate, bounded pointer-capture interval for the XmpIcon visual test only after clarifying the reported screen-activation trigger; release with AltGr and verify the host pointer is outside afterward.
